verifications.claim: Dyslexia affects 1 in 14 people.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R1: 'estimates of the rate of dyslexia in kids range from 5 to 17.5 percent'; R2: '6–7% ... 15–20% of the population as a whole—have some of the symptoms'
verifications.reasoning: Prevalence estimates in sources (5-20%) encompass ~7% (1/14), but no exact match for '1 in 14'.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources describe it as neurodevelopmental or brain-based, synonymous with neurobiological.
